description: Store artistic intent on the existing Game Kit project (game.engine), separately from gameplay: look, world/theme, palette, proportions/materials/lighting notes and device budget. Read first, then set with expected_revision. Unspecified fields are preserved; null clears a field or the profile. Existing assets and rendering are not modified. Use this direction with map wizard.look, VFX look, asset prompts, lighting and UI tools, then inspect gripforge_game_asset_plan and actual-engine captures. 0 credits.

action.description: get reads the profile/revision; set applies a partial profile update.

look.description: Rendering look, separate from the game style: stylized (neutral) | painted | toon | anime | realistic | lowpoly | pixel. Old values (handpainted, cartoon, low_poly…) are read as aliases. Omit for the style default.

art_direction.description: set: shared project art direction patch. Null clears the profile or an individual field.

expected_revision.description: set: revision returned by get; stale changes are refused.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_game_art_direction
title: Read or update the shared art direction of a game
